what_student_did.description: Brief private account of what the student's message did: e.g. used an idea, explained it, repeated it, avoided it, answered or redirected.

evidence_strength.description: Private judgment of how strong the evidence in this turn was.

evidence_independence.description: Whether the evidence depended mainly on tutor-supplied setup, method, or reasoning.

response_fit.description: Optional note on whether the student responded to what was asked or productively went elsewhere.

salient_issue.description: Optional note on a real misunderstanding, skipped step, affective state, or procedural/off-task issue that mattered this turn.

next_move.description: What the tutor chose to do next on this turn.

why_this_move.description: Why that move was chosen, in light of the student's message, route, time, and priorities.

student_steered.description: Whether the student set the direction for this turn.

route_or_focus.description: Private description of the route being followed or the current student-chosen focus.

current_stop.description: Private description of the current stop or local target.

movement.description: How the conversation moved relative to the route or focus.

amount.description: How much help the tutor gave.

why_that_much.description: Why this amount of help was appropriate.

note.description: Optional brief note if any self-check item was close, required care, or constrained the turn.
